points.description: Correctly identifies N1 as the node that was never a leader in any of the three terms (the answer must name N1 and no other node).

Justifies by naming a plausible leader for each term with the correct technical reasoning: N4 (log a, b, c) for term 1, N3 (log a, b, p, q, r, s) for term 2, and N2 (log a, b, p, q, x, y, z) for term 3, so N1 is not needed as leader in any term. All three term-leader assignments must be stated.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) only if two of the three term-leader assignments are stated correctly and none is wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks need N1 named as the never-leader (P1) and all three term leaders (N4 term 1, N3 term 2, N2 term 3) stated as the justification (P2). Naming N1 with no or wrong justification earns only P1. A wrong node as the answer earns 0 for P1, and any wrong leader assignment in P2 means P2 earns nothing.
